notes:
- Company: mid-market search SaaS (customer-facing search + personalization). Want to improve relevance for ecomm and docs.
- Primary ask: rerank endpoint (model-based reordering) to replace heuristics. Current flow: candidate generation via embeddings -> heavy heuristic scoring -> static sort. Want model-in-the-loop rerank for top 50 candidates.
- Eval set: ~120k historical queries + 50k labeled relevance judgments (NDCG/Recall targets). Will run offline scoring job nightly to re-score index updates.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 <150ms for rerank top-10 in hosted flow; sustained 200 qps daytime, burst to 600 qps. Cost sensitive: want guidance on batching vs latency tradeoffs.
- POC plan: 2-week hosted API POC (re-rank endpoint) using subset of traffic (1%) + offline replay on full eval set. Team will provide sample logs and eval labels.
- Model preference: open/model-agnostic; prefer smaller quantized candidate reranker for cost but need accuracy comparable to current tree-based model. Interested in Redwood Optimize for quantization recommendations and batching configs.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration (Okta), audit logging, key management via KMS, US data residency for production. Dedicated requirement likely if POC meets metrics.
- Pricing: asked for committed capacity pricing vs pure usage (prefer predictable unit economics). AE discussed Dedicated reserve options and burst policies.
- Quote from PM: "We need reranking that beats our heuristics while keeping search latency under 150ms — otherwise we can't ship." 
- Action items: send POC checklist + hosted token allotment estimate; share rerank eval harness template; legal to review data residency appendix (drive link).
